items.title: Verstappen wins in Singapore on his 250th start
items.summary: Max Verstappen led every lap at Marina Bay for his first win there, with Charles Leclerc second and Kimi Antonelli third.

items.title: Antonelli could clinch the title in Austin
items.summary: Antonelli can become the youngest champion at the US GP on Oct 25, but only if he wins, George Russell finishes ninth or lower, and Lewis Hamilton finishes fifth or lower.

items.title: Red Bull keeps Mekies through 2031
items.summary: Red Bull extended team boss Laurent Mekies's contract to 2031 as it builds on its recent turnaround.

items.title: Racing Bulls still deciding its 2027 line-up
items.summary: Team principal Alan Permane says Liam Lawson, Arvid Lindblad and F2 driver Nikola Tsolov are in contention for two seats, with a call due in the coming weeks.

items.title: Haas seat: Camara vs. Doohan
items.summary: With Esteban Ocon leaving Haas, Ferrari junior Rafa Camara and Jack Doohan are reportedly the two front-runners for the 2027 seat. Nothing is confirmed yet.

items.title: Cadillac may change both drivers
items.summary: A Swiss newspaper report says Cadillac is weighing replacing both Sergio Perez and Valtteri Bottas for 2027, possibly opening a door for Ocon. The team hasn't commented.
